Under default features (xgrammar OFF), the tests panic on the bail! in the non-xgrammar branch. Gating them away makes the symptoms disappear while the broken code path persists untested.

results.verdict_reason: The compilation failed due to an unterminated character literal in tests/nested_strictness.rs that was not introduced by the current task — yet the agent ran `cargo test --release batched_fill` with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2, which caused the entire workspace to build serially, pulling in a known-broken test file and aborting the entire run before the target test ever executed. This is unprofessional because: (1) the agent should have used `--test batched_fill` (not workspace) or `--tests` with a filter that excludes the broken file; (2) the broken file was present before this session and should have been noted/excluded; (3) the tool call wasted 2+ minutes recompiling known-dead code instead of running the single isolated test.
results.verdict_suggestion: Use `cargo test --test batched_fill` (or `--tests batched_fill` with explicit workspace exclusion) to build and run ONLY the new test file, not the entire workspace. If other test files have pre-existing compilation errors, exclude them via `--tests` filters or a Cargo.toml `test` configuration, or fix the broken file first so it doesn't poison every subsequent test run.
